nl: Consider a finite account universe with signed balances. Starting from any ledger, after any finite sequence of journal entries such that every entry is balanced, the total balance is unchanged. In particular, if the opening ledger has total balance zero, the posted ledger also has total balance zero. This proves that balanced multi-leg journals cannot create single-sided value across any admissib
lean_statement:
universe u

abbrev Ledger (Account : Type u) : Type u :=
  Account → Int

/-- One signed amount posted to one account. -/

structure Leg (Account : Type u) where
  account : Account
  amount : Int

/-- One journal entry, represented by its finite list of legs. -/

abbrev Entry (Account : Type u) : Type u :=
  List (Leg Account)

/-- A finite sequence of journal entries. -/

abbrev Journal (Account : Type u) : Type u :=
  List (Entry Account)

/-- The signed sum of all leg amounts in an entry. -/

def entrySum {Account : Type u} (entry : Entry Account) : Int :=
  (entry.map fun leg ↦ leg.amount).sum

/-- An entry is balanced when its signed leg amounts sum to zero. -/

def BalancedEntry {Account : Type u} (entry : Entry Account) : Prop :=
  entrySum entry = 0

/-- Apply one leg to a ledger by adding the leg amount at exactly its target account. -/

def applyLeg {Account : Type u} [DecidableEq Account]
    (ledger : Ledger Account) (leg : Leg Account) : Ledger Account :=
  Function.update ledger leg.account (ledger leg.account + leg.amount)

/-- Apply all legs of one entry in submitted order. -/

def applyEntry {Account : Type u} [DecidableEq Account]
    (ledger : Ledger Account) (entry : Entry Account) : Ledger Account :=
  entry.foldl applyLeg ledger

/-- Post a finite journal by applying each entry in submitted order. -/

def postJournal {Account : Type u} [DecidableEq Account]
    (ledger : Ledger Account) (journal : Journal Account) : Ledger Account :=
  journal.foldl applyEntry ledger

/-- Sum all balances over the finite account universe. -/

def totalBalance {Account : Type u} [Fintype Account] (ledger : Ledger Account) : Int :=
  Finset.univ.sum ledger

theorem balanced_journal_conservation_zero_endpoint_and_separate_sharpness
    {Account : Type u} [Fintype Account] [DecidableEq Account] :
    (∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) {journal : Journal Account},
      (∀ entry ∈ journal, BalancedEntry entry) →
        totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = totalBalance ledger ∧
          (totalBalance ledger = 0 →
            totalBalance (postJournal ledger journal) = 0)) ∧
      (∀ (ledger : Ledger Account) (account : Account) {amount : Int},
        amount ≠ 0 →
          ¬ BalancedEntry ([{ account := account, amount := amount }] : Entry Account) ∧
            totalBalance
                (applyEntry ledger ([{ account := account, amount := amount }] : Entry Account)) ≠
              totalBalance ledger) := by
  sorry

nl: Over an arbitrary finite nonempty outcome space, an arbitrary finite agent set, and quasi-linear valuations in a linearly ordered field, DEFINE the VCG mechanism (welfare-maximizing allocation + Clarke pivot payment) and prove all three: 1. **Dominant-strategy truthfulness (DSIC).** For every agent `i`, every true valuation `v i`, every profile of the others' reports `r₋ᵢ`, and every misreport `rᵢ
lean_statement:
open BigOperators
open scoped BigOperators

namespace VCG

abbrev Valuation (Outcome K : Type*) := Outcome → K

abbrev ValuationProfile (Agent Outcome K : Type*) := Agent → Valuation Outcome K

noncomputable def finiteMax
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [LinearOrder β] (f : α → β) : β :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty f

def socialWelfare
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (a : Outcome) : K :=
  ∑ i : Agent, r i a

def othersWelfare
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) (a : Outcome) : K :=
  Finset.sum (Finset.univ.erase i) (fun j => r j a)

def updateReport
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [DecidableEq Agent]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) (vi : Valuation Outcome K) :
    ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K :=
  fun j => if j = i then vi else r j

noncomputable def pivotBenchmark
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  finiteMax (fun a : Outcome => othersWelfare r i a)

def IsWelfareMaximizer
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LE K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (a : Outcome) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Outcome, socialWelfare r b ≤ socialWelfare r a

axiom exists_welfareMaximizer
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LinearOrder K]
    [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome] (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) :
    ∃ a : Outcome, IsWelfareMaximizer r a

noncomputable def vcgAllocation
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LinearOrder K]
    [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome] (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) : Outcome :=
  Classical.choose (exists_welfareMaximizer r)

axiom vcgAllocation_isWelfareMaximizer
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LinearOrder K]
    [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome] (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) :
    IsWelfareMaximizer r (vcgAllocation r)

noncomputable def clarkePivotPayment
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  pivotBenchmark r i - othersWelfare r i (vcgAllocation r)

noncomputable def quasilinearUtility
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    (trueVal : Valuation Outcome K) (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  trueVal (vcgAllocation r) - clarkePivotPayment r i

def DominantStrategyTruthful
    (Agent Outcome K : Type*) [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    [CovariantClass K K (fun x y => x + y) (· ≤ ·)] : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Agent) (trueVal : Valuation Outcome K)
    (othersReports : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (misreport : Valuation Outcome K),
    quasilinearUtility trueVal (updateReport othersReports i trueVal) i ≥
      quasilinearUtility trueVal (updateReport othersReports i misreport) i

structure VCGMechanism
    (Agent Outcome K : Type*) [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    [CovariantClass K K (fun x y => x + y) (· ≤ ·)] where
  allocation : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K → Outcome
  payment : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K → Agent → K
  welfare_maximizing :
    ∀ r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K, IsWelfareMaximizer r (allocation r)
  payment_is_clarke_pivot :
    ∀ (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent),
      payment r i = clarkePivotPayment r i

noncomputable def vcgMechanism
    (Agent Outcome K : Type*) [Fintype Agent]

nl: Envy-freeness implies EF1: if no agent envies another, then removing any one good from another's bundle only

namespace EF1Allocation

variable {Agent Item K : Type*}
variable [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Valuation (Item K : Type*) [Zero K] [LE K] where
  value : Item → K
  nonneg : ∀ g : Item, 0 ≤ value g

def bundleValue (v : Valuation Item K) (bundle : Finset Item) : K :=
  Finset.sum bundle fun g => v.value g

structure Allocation (Agent Item : Type*) where
  owner : Item → Agent

def bundle [DecidableEq Agent]
    (goods : Finset Item) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i : Agent) : Finset Item :=
  goods.filter fun g => allocation.owner g = i

def Envies [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i j : Agent) : Prop :=
  bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) <
    bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation j)

def EnvyFree [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, ¬ Envies profile goods allocation i j

def DoesNotEnvyUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i j : Agent) : Prop :=
  (bundle goods allocation j).Nonempty →
    ∃ g ∈ bundle goods allocation j,
      bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) ≥
        bundleValue (profile i) ((bundle goods allocation j).erase g)

def EnvyFreeUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, DoesNotEnvyUpToOneGood profile goods allocation i j

theorem EnvyFree.EnvyFreeUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    {profile : Agent → Valuation Item K} {goods : Finset Item}
    {allocation : Allocation Agent Item}
    (hEF : EnvyFree profile goods allocation) :
    EnvyFreeUpToOneGood profile goods allocation := by
  sorry

end EF1Allocation

nl: Round-robin is EF1: for any additive profile, the round-robin allocation makes each earlier-in-order agent

namespace EF1Allocation

variable {Agent Item K : Type*}
variable [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Valuation (Item K : Type*) [Zero K] [LE K] where
  value : Item → K
  nonneg : ∀ g : Item, 0 ≤ value g

def bundleValue (v : Valuation Item K) (bundle : Finset Item) : K :=
  Finset.sum bundle fun g => v.value g

structure Allocation (Agent Item : Type*) where
  owner : Item → Agent

def bundle [DecidableEq Agent]
    (goods : Finset Item) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i : Agent) : Finset Item :=
  goods.filter fun g => allocation.owner g = i

def EnvyFreeUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, (bundle goods allocation j).Nonempty →
    ∃ g ∈ bundle goods allocation j,
      bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) ≥
        bundleValue (profile i) ((bundle goods allocation j).erase g)

def pickedItems [DecidableEq Item] (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Finset Item :=
  (picks.map Prod.snd).toFinset

def remainingItems [DecidableEq Item]
    (goods : Finset Item) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) (n : Nat) : Finset Item :=
  goods \ ((picks.take n).map Prod.snd).toFinset

def PickLogRoundRobin [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (order : List Agent) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Prop :=
  ∃ hlen : 0 < order.length,
    (picks.map Prod.snd).Nodup ∧
      pickedItems (Item := Item) picks = goods ∧
        ∀ n (hn : n < picks.length),
          let pick := picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩
          pick.1 = order.get ⟨n % order.length, Nat.mod_lt n hlen⟩ ∧
            pick.2 ∈ remainingItems goods picks n ∧
              ∀ g ∈ remainingItems goods picks n,
                (profile pick.1).value g ≤ (profile pick.1).value pick.2

def PickLogMatchesAllocation
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Prop :=
  ∀ n (hn : n < picks.length),
    allocation.owner (picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩).2 = (picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩).1

def RoundRobin [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (order : List Agent) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∃ picks : List (Agent × Item),
    PickLogRoundRobin profile goods order picks ∧
      PickLogMatchesAllocation allocation picks

theorem RoundRobin_EnvyFreeUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    {profile : Agent → Valuation Item K} {goods : Finset Item}
    {order : List Agent} {allocation : Allocation Agent Item}
    (hrr : RoundRobin profile goods order allocation) :
    EnvyFreeUpToOneGood profile goods allocation := by
  sorry

end EF1Allocation

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where

inductive Side where
  | bid
  | ask
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Side

def opposite : Side → Side
  | bid => ask
  | ask => bid

def betterPrice {K : Type*} [LinearOrder K] : Side → K → K → Prop
  | bid, x, y => y < x
  | ask, x, y => x < y

end Side

structure Order (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  side : Side
  price : K
  arrival : T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

/-- A raw resting book, represented by lists on each side. -/

structure Book (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  bids : List (Order K T)
  asks : List (Order K T)

section CentralLimitOrderBook

variable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] [LT T]

def emptyBook : Book K T :=
  {
    bids := [],
    asks := []
  }

/-- Select the queue belonging to a side. -/

def ordersOnSide (book : Book K T) : Side → List (Order K T)
  | Side.bid => book.bids
  | Side.ask => book.asks

def restOrder (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid => { bids := incoming :: book.bids, asks := book.asks }
  | Side.ask => { bids := book.bids, asks := incoming :: book.asks }

def bidPrices (book : Book K T) : List K :=
  book.bids.map (fun order => order.price)

/-- Ask-side prices as a Mathlib list of ordered values. -/

def askPrices (book : Book K T) : List K :=
  book.asks.map (fun order => order.price)

/-- Ask-side prices in the order dual, so a minimum ask is a maximum dual price. -/

def askPricesDual (book : Book K T) : List Kᵒᵈ :=
  book.asks.map (fun order => OrderDual.toDual order.price)

/-- The maximum resting bid price over all bids, if the side is populated. -/

def bestBid (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  (bidPrices book).max?

/-- The minimum resting ask price over all asks, if the side is populated. -/

def bestAsk (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  ((askPricesDual book).max?).map (fun price => OrderDual.ofDual price)

def PriorityAhead (x y : Order K T) : Prop :=
  x.side = y.side ∧
    (Side.betterPrice x.side x.price y.price ∨
      (x.price = y.price ∧ x.arrival < y.arrival))

def PrioritySorted (orders : List (Order K T)) : Prop :=
  orders.Pairwise PriorityAhead

def SideConsistent (side : Side) (orders : List (Order K T)) : Prop :=
  ∀ order ∈ orders, order.side = side

structure BookWellFormed (book : Book K T) : Prop where
  bids_side : SideConsistent Side.bid book.bids
  asks_side : SideConsistent Side.ask book.asks
  bids_sorted : PrioritySorted book.bids
  asks_sorted : PrioritySorted book.asks

def Uncrossed (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ bid ask, bestBid book = some bid → bestAsk book = some ask → bid < ask

def Marketable (incoming : Order K T) (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid => ∃ ask, bestAsk book = some ask ∧ ask ≤ incoming.price
  | Side.ask => ∃ bid, bestBid book = some bid ∧ incoming.price ≤ bid

noncomputable def matchInto (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T := by
  classical
  exact if Marketable incoming book then book else restOrder book incoming

structure FillEvent (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  incoming : Order K T
  resting : Order K T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

/-- A fill respects strict price-time priority relative to the residual book.

-- @vacuity-scope: `FillRespectsPriority`: this is vacuous when the residual list
-- `ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side` is empty.
-/

def FillRespectsPriority (after : Book K T) (fill : FillEvent K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ order ∈ ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side,
    ¬ PriorityAhead order fill.resting

def StrictPriceTimeExecution
    (after : Book K T) (fills : List (FillEvent K T)) : Prop :=
  ∀ fill ∈ fills, FillRespectsPriority after fill

def cancelOrder [DecidableEq T] (side : Side) (arrival : T)
    (book : Book K T) : Book K T :=
  match side with
  | Side.bid =>
      { bids := book.bids.filter (fun order => order.arrival ≠ arrival)
        asks := book.asks }
  | Side.ask =>
      { bids := book.bids
        asks := book.asks.filter (fun order => order.arrival ≠ arrival) }

inductive Operation (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  | limit (incoming : Order K T)
  | market (side : Side) (qty : K) (qty_pos : 0 < qty)
  | cancel (side : Side) (arrival : T)

noncomputable def applyOp [DecidableEq T]
    (book : Book K T) : Operation K T → Book K T
  | Operation.limit incoming => matchInto book incoming
  | Operation.market _ _ _ => book
  | Operation.cancel side arrival => cancelOrder side arrival book

noncomputable def postOps [DecidableEq T]
    (book : Book K T) (ops : List (Operation K T)) : Book K T :=
  ops.foldl applyOp book

theorem central_limit_order_book_trace_uncrossed
    [DecidableEq T]
    (initial : Book K T) (hinitial : Uncrossed initial)
    (ops : List (Operation K T)) :
    ∀ state ∈ List.scanl applyOp initial ops, Uncrossed state := by
  sorry

end CentralLimitOrderBook

            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (women : List Woman) : Prop :=
  women.Pairwise (fun w₁ w₂ => prefM.pref m w₁ w₂)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  if hfree : freeMan state.matching m then
    match state.rem m with
    | [] => state
    | w :: tail =>
        let nextHeld :=
          match state.matching.held w with
          | none => some m
          | some old => some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)

          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }
  else
    state

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  postProposals prefW initial schedule = state

def Quiescent [DecidableEq Man] (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

theorem quiescent_reachable_state_has_no_blocking_pair
    [Fintype Man] [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (fullList : Man → List Woman) (schedule : List Man) {state : ProposalState Man Woman}
    (hSound : ProposalListsSound prefM fullList)
    (hRun : ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) schedule state)
    (hQuiet : Quiescent state) :
    ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW state.matching m w := by
  sorry

end States

end GaleShapleyStableMatchingProbe

structure StrictPreference (Agent : Type u) (Alt : Type v) where
  pref : Agent → Alt → Alt → Prop
  decidablePref : ∀ agent x y, Decidable (pref agent x y)

section Preferences

variable {Agent : Type u} {Alt : Type v}

def WeaklyPrefers (prefs : StrictPreference Agent Alt)

section Choice

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=

end Choice

section Matching

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/
def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=

def freeMan [DecidableEq Man] (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

  unfold freeMan

  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

def updateHeld [DecidableEq Woman]
    (held : Woman → Option Man) (w : Woman) (newHeld : Option Man) :
    Woman → Option Man :=
  fun w' => if w' = w then newHeld else held w'

end Matching

section Stability

variable {Man : Type u} {Woman : Type v}

def ManPrefersOption (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)
    (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Option Woman → Prop
  | none => True
  | some w' => prefM.pref m w w'

def WomanPrefersOption (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (m : Man) : Option Man → Prop
  | none => True
  | some m' => prefW.pref w m m'

noncomputable def ManPrefersCurrent [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) :
    Prop :=
  ManPrefersOption prefM m w (partnerOfMan μ m)

noncomputable def BlockingPair [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) (w : Woman) : Prop :=
  ManPrefersCurrent prefM μ m w ∧ WomanPrefersOption prefW w m (μ.held w)

noncomputable def Stable [DecidableEq Man]
    (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman) (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ m w, ¬ BlockingPair prefM prefW μ m w

end Stability

structure ProposalState (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  matching : Matching Man Woman

  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalListOrdered (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)

def ProposalListsSound (prefM : StrictPreference Man Woman)

  ∀ m, (fullList m).Nodup ∧ ProposalListOrdered prefM m (fullList m)

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]

          rem := Function.update state.rem m tail }

def postProposals [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  schedule.foldl (proposalStep prefW) state

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]
    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=

inductive Side where
  | bid
  | ask
  deriving DecidableEq

def opposite : Side → Side
  | Side.bid => Side.ask
  | Side.ask => Side.bid

def betterPrice {K : Type*} [LT K] : Side → K → K → Prop
  | Side.bid, x, y => y < x
  | Side.ask, x, y => x < y

structure Order (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LT K] where
  side : Side
  price : K
  arrival : T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

/-- A raw resting book, represented by priority queues on each side. -/

structure Book (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LT K] where
  bids : List (Order K T)
  asks : List (Order K T)

def emptyBook {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] : Book K T :=
  {
    bids := [],
    asks := []
  }

/-- Select the queue belonging to a side. -/

def ordersOnSide {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] (book : Book K T) :
    Side → List (Order K T)
  | Side.bid => book.bids
  | Side.ask => book.asks

def restOrder {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K]
    (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid =>
      {
        bids := incoming :: book.bids,
        asks := book.asks
      }
  | Side.ask =>
      {
        bids := book.bids,
        asks := incoming :: book.asks
      }

def bestBid {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  book.bids.head?.map (fun order => order.price)

/-- The lowest resting ask price, if any.  The list head is the best order. -/

def bestAsk {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  book.asks.head?.map (fun order => order.price)

def PriorityAhead {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LT T]
    (x y : Order K T) : Prop :=
  x.side = y.side ∧
    (betterPrice x.side x.price y.price ∨
      (x.price = y.price ∧ x.arrival < y.arrival))

def PrioritySorted {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LT T]
    (orders : List (Order K T)) : Prop :=
  orders.Pairwise PriorityAhead

def Uncrossed {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ bid ask, bestBid book = some bid → bestAsk book = some ask → bid < ask

def Marketable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LE K]
    (incoming : Order K T) (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid => ∃ ask, bestAsk book = some ask ∧ ask ≤ incoming.price
  | Side.ask => ∃ bid, bestBid book = some bid ∧ incoming.price ≤ bid

noncomputable def matchInto {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LE K]
    (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T := by
  classical
  exact if Marketable incoming book then book else restOrder book incoming

structure FillEvent (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LT K] where
  incoming : Order K T
  resting : Order K T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

/-- A fill respects strict price-time priority relative to the residual book:
no order with strictly higher priority than the filled resting order remains on
the filled side.

-- @vacuity-scope: FillRespectsPriority: this is vacuous when the residual list
-- `ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side` is empty.  A later trace theorem that
-- asserts an actual fill must separately supply a `FillEvent` witness.
-/

def FillRespectsPriority {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LT T]
    (after : Book K T) (fill : FillEvent K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ order ∈ ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side,
    ¬ PriorityAhead order fill.resting

def StrictPriceTimeExecution {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [LT T]
    (after : Book K T) (fills : List (FillEvent K T)) : Prop :=
  ∀ fill ∈ fills, FillRespectsPriority after fill

def cancelOrder {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LT K] [DecidableEq T]
    (side : Side) (arrival : T) (book : Book K T) : Book K T :=
  match side with
  | Side.bid =>
      { bids := book.bids.filter (fun order => order.arrival ≠ arrival)
        asks := book.asks }
  | Side.ask =>
      { bids := book.bids
        asks := book.asks.filter (fun order => order.arrival ≠ arrival) }

inductive Operation (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LT K] where

structure PoolState where
  reserveX : ℝ≥0
  reserveY : ℝ≥0
deriving DecidableEq

/-- A raw-pair candidate kept as a denotational bridge for the chosen structure. -/

abbrev PoolPair := ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0

/-- Convert a named pool state to the Mathlib product representation. -/

def PoolState.toPair (p : PoolState) : PoolPair :=
  (p.reserveX, p.reserveY)

/-- Convert a Mathlib product representation to the selected named structure. -/

def PoolState.ofPair (p : PoolPair) : PoolState :=
  ⟨p.1, p.2⟩

/-- Product invariant `k = x * y`. -/

def productInvariant (p : PoolState) : ℝ≥0 :=
  p.reserveX * p.reserveY

/-- A pool is alive exactly when both reserves are strictly positive. -/

def PoolState.WellFormed (p : PoolState) : Prop :=
  0 < p.reserveX ∧ 0 < p.reserveY

def IsFeeFactor (γ : ℝ≥0) : Prop :=
  0 < γ ∧ γ ≤ 1

/-- A fee factor `γ`, the input fraction that trades against the curve. -/

structure FeeFactor where
  val : ℝ≥0
  pos : 0 < val
  le_one : val ≤ 1

instance : Coe FeeFactor ℝ≥0 where
  coe γ := γ.val

/-- The feeless boundary `γ = 1`. -/

def FeeFactor.feeless : FeeFactor :=
  ⟨1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩

inductive TradeDirection where
  | xToY
  | yToX
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A trade is a direction and a nonnegative input amount. -/

structure Trade where
  direction : TradeDirection
  amount : ℝ≥0
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Anchor: the `NNReal` amount field is a primitive nonnegative quantity. -/

def Trade.xToY (dx : ℝ≥0) : Trade :=
  ⟨TradeDirection.xToY, dx⟩

/-- A one-token Y-to-X trade constructor. -/

def Trade.yToX (dy : ℝ≥0) : Trade :=
  ⟨TradeDirection.yToX, dy⟩

def swapXToY (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dx : ℝ≥0) : PoolState :=
  { reserveX := p.reserveX + dx
    reserveY := p.reserveX * p.reserveY / (p.reserveX + (γ : ℝ≥0) * dx) }

/-- Closed-form post-state for swapping Y input into the pool for X output. -/

def swapYToX (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dy : ℝ≥0) : PoolState :=
  { reserveX := p.reserveX * p.reserveY / (p.reserveY + (γ : ℝ≥0) * dy)
    reserveY := p.reserveY + dy }

/-- Y proceeds paid out by an X-to-Y swap, in subtraction-free form. -/

def outputYOfXToY (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dx : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  p.reserveY * ((γ : ℝ≥0) * dx) / (p.reserveX + (γ : ℝ≥0) * dx)

/-- X proceeds paid out by a Y-to-X swap, in subtraction-free form. -/

def outputXOfYToX (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dy : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  p.reserveX * ((γ : ℝ≥0) * dy) / (p.reserveY + (γ : ℝ≥0) * dy)

/-- Anchor: the X-to-Y transition is exactly the closed-form reserve formula. -/

def applyTrade (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (t : Trade) : PoolState :=
  match t.direction with
  | TradeDirection.xToY => swapXToY γ p t.amount
  | TradeDirection.yToX => swapYToX γ p t.amount

def executeTrades (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (ts : List Trade) : PoolState :=
  ts.foldl (applyTrade γ) p

/-- Anchor: sequence execution is the trusted Mathlib `List.foldl`. -/

def tradeTrace (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (ts : List Trade) : List PoolState :=
  p :: (ts.scanl (applyTrade γ) p).tail

/-- Anchor: the trace is pinned to Mathlib's `List.scanl` prefix semantics. -/

def roundTripXReturn (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dx : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  outputXOfYToX γ (swapXToY γ p dx) (outputYOfXToY γ p dx)

/-- Y returned after an immediate Y-to-X then X-to-Y round trip. -/

def roundTripYReturn (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dy : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0 :=
  outputYOfXToY γ (swapYToX γ p dy) (outputXOfYToX γ p dy)

/-- Anchor: the X round-trip return is the composition of the two output formulas. -/

theorem swapXToY_wellFormed (γ : FeeFactor) (p : PoolState) (dx : ℝ≥0)
    (hp : p.WellFormed) : (swapXToY γ p dx).WellFormed := by
  sorry

namespace EF1Allocation

variable {Agent Item K : Type*}
variable [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Valuation (Item K : Type*) [Zero K] [LE K] where
  value : Item → K
  nonneg : ∀ g : Item, 0 ≤ value g

def bundleValue (v : Valuation Item K) (bundle : Finset Item) : K :=
  Finset.sum bundle fun g => v.value g

structure Allocation (Agent Item : Type*) where
  owner : Item → Agent

def bundle [DecidableEq Agent]
    (goods : Finset Item) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i : Agent) : Finset Item :=
  goods.filter fun g => allocation.owner g = i

def Envies [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i j : Agent) : Prop :=
  bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) <
    bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation j)

def EnvyFree [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, ¬ Envies profile goods allocation i j

abbrev TwoAgent := Fin 2

abbrev OneGoodItem := Fin 1

def oneGoodSet : Finset OneGoodItem :=
  {(0 : OneGoodItem)}

def oneGoodPositiveValuation : Valuation OneGoodItem K :=
  { value := fun _ => 1
    nonneg := by intro _; norm_num }

def twoAgentOneGoodProfile : TwoAgent → Valuation OneGoodItem K :=
  fun _ => oneGoodPositiveValuation

    (allocation : Allocation TwoAgent OneGoodItem) :
    ¬ EnvyFree (twoAgentOneGoodProfile (K := K)) oneGoodSet allocation := by

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Position (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  collateral : K
  debt : K
  collateral_nonneg : 0 ≤ collateral
  debt_nonneg : 0 ≤ debt

def CollateralFactor (theta : K) : Prop :=
  0 < theta ∧ theta ≤ 1

/-- A position is healthy when debt is within its collateral-factor capacity. -/

def Healthy (theta : K) (p : Position K) : Prop :=
  p.debt ≤ theta * p.collateral

/-- A position is liquidatable when debt strictly exceeds capacity. -/

def Liquidatable (theta : K) (p : Position K) : Prop :=
  theta * p.collateral < p.debt

/-- Undercollateralization gap; nonpositive exactly on healthy states. -/

def healthGap (theta : K) (p : Position K) : K :=

def borrowAction (amount : K) (hamount : 0 ≤ amount) : UserAction K :=

def withdrawAction (amount : K) (hamount : 0 ≤ amount) : UserAction K :=

inductive Side where
  | bid
  | ask
  deriving DecidableEq

def opposite : Side → Side
  | Side.bid => Side.ask
  | Side.ask => Side.bid

def betterPrice {K : Type*} [LinearOrder K] : Side → K → K → Prop
  | Side.bid, x, y => y < x
  | Side.ask, x, y => x < y

namespace Side

abbrev betterPrice {K : Type*} [LinearOrder K] : Side → K → K → Prop :=
  _root_.betterPrice

end Side

structure Order (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  side : Side
  price : K
  arrival : T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

/-- A raw resting book, represented by lists on each side. -/

structure Book (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  bids : List (Order K T)
  asks : List (Order K T)

section Established

variable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LinearOrder K]

def emptyBook : Book K T :=
  {
    bids := [],
    asks := []
  }

/-- Select the queue belonging to a side. -/

def ordersOnSide (book : Book K T) : Side → List (Order K T)
  | Side.bid => book.bids
  | Side.ask => book.asks

def restOrder (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid => { bids := incoming :: book.bids, asks := book.asks }
  | Side.ask => { bids := book.bids, asks := incoming :: book.asks }

def bidPrices (book : Book K T) : List K :=
  book.bids.map (fun order => order.price)

/-- Ask-side prices as a Mathlib list of ordered values. -/

def askPrices (book : Book K T) : List K :=
  book.asks.map (fun order => order.price)

/-- Ask-side prices in the order dual, so a minimum ask is a maximum dual price. -/

def askPricesDual (book : Book K T) : List Kᵒᵈ :=
  book.asks.map (fun order => OrderDual.toDual order.price)

/-- The maximum resting bid price over all bids, if the side is populated. -/

def bestBid (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  (bidPrices book).max?

/-- The minimum resting ask price over all asks, if the side is populated. -/

def bestAsk (book : Book K T) : Option K :=
  ((askPricesDual book).max?).map (fun price => OrderDual.ofDual price)

end Established

section Priority

variable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] [LT T]

def PriorityAhead (x y : Order K T) : Prop :=
  x.side = y.side ∧
    (Side.betterPrice x.side x.price y.price ∨
      (x.price = y.price ∧ x.arrival < y.arrival))

def PrioritySorted (orders : List (Order K T)) : Prop :=
  orders.Pairwise PriorityAhead

def SideConsistent (side : Side) (orders : List (Order K T)) : Prop :=
  ∀ order ∈ orders, order.side = side

structure BookWellFormed (book : Book K T) : Prop where
  bids_side : SideConsistent Side.bid book.bids
  asks_side : SideConsistent Side.ask book.asks
  bids_sorted : PrioritySorted book.bids
  asks_sorted : PrioritySorted book.asks

end Priority

section Market

variable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LinearOrder K]

def Uncrossed (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ bid ask, bestBid book = some bid → bestAsk book = some ask → bid < ask

def Marketable (incoming : Order K T) (book : Book K T) : Prop :=
  match incoming.side with
  | Side.bid =>
      match bestAsk book with
      | some ask => ask ≤ incoming.price
      | none => False
  | Side.ask =>
      match bestBid book with
      | some bid => incoming.price ≤ bid
      | none => False

instance instDecidableMarketable (incoming : Order K T) (book : Book K T) :
    Decidable (Marketable incoming book) := by
  unfold Marketable
  cases incoming.side <;>
    first
      | cases bestAsk book <;> infer_instance
      | cases bestBid book <;> infer_instance

def matchInto (book : Book K T) (incoming : Order K T) : Book K T :=
  if Marketable incoming book then book else restOrder book incoming

end Market

structure FillEvent (K T : Type*) [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] where
  incoming : Order K T
  resting : Order K T
  qty : K
  qty_pos : 0 < qty

section Execution

variable {K T : Type*} [Zero K] [LinearOrder K] [LT T]

/-- A fill respects strict price-time priority relative to the residual book.

-- @vacuity-scope: `FillRespectsPriority`: this is vacuous when the residual list
-- `ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side` is empty.
-/

def FillRespectsPriority (after : Book K T) (fill : FillEvent K T) : Prop :=
  ∀ order ∈ ordersOnSide after fill.resting.side,
    ¬ PriorityAhead order fill.resting

def StrictPriceTimeExecution
    (after : Book K T) (fills : List (FillEvent K T)) : Prop :=
  ∀ fill ∈ fills, FillRespectsPriority after fill

end Execution

    match (if useMin then idxs.head? else idxs.getLast?) with

def adj (a b : Cell) : Bool :=
  ((a.1 == b.1) && (a.2 + 1 == b.2 || b.2 + 1 == a.2)) ||
  ((a.2 == b.2) && (a.1 + 1 == b.1 || b.1 + 1 == a.1))

def growOnce (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell × List Cell :=
  let added := rest.filter (fun c => comp.any (fun k => adj k c))
  (comp ++ added, rest.filter (fun c => ! comp.any (fun k => adj k c)))

def component (seed : Cell) (cells : List Cell) (fuel : Nat) : List Cell :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => [seed]
  | Nat.succ f =>
    let rec go (n : Nat) (comp rest : List Cell) : List Cell :=
      match n with
      | 0 => comp
      | Nat.succ m =>
        let (c2, r2) := growOnce comp rest
        if c2.length = comp.length then comp else go m c2 r2
    go (Nat.succ f) [seed] (cells.filter (fun c => c ≠ seed))

  ((List.range g.length).map fun y =>

  let cells := matchCells g colors
  let rec go (n : Nat) (remaining : List Cell) (acc : List (List Cell)) : List (List Cell) :=
    match n, remaining with
    | 0, _ => acc
    | _, [] => acc
    | Nat.succ m, seed :: _ =>
      let comp := component seed remaining remaining.length

    let ny := (c.1 : Int) + dy
    let nx := (c.2 : Int) + dx

    decide (0 ≤ nx) && decide (nx < ((g.getD 0 []).length : Int)) &&

def translateBlock (g : Grid) (colors : List Nat) (dy dx : Int) (destOk : List Nat)

  | liability
  | equity

  equationSign p.accountType * p.amount

  | [] => 0
  | p :: ps => postingResidual p + entryResidual ps

  entryResidual e = 0

  liabilities : K
  equity : K

  l.assets - l.liabilities - l.equity

abbrev Nodes (n : ℕ) := Fin n

/-- A quorum/fault set over `n` nodes. -/
abbrev NodeSet (n : ℕ) := Finset (Nodes n)

/-- An at-most-`f` faulty set. -/
def FaultAdmissible (n f : ℕ) (F : NodeSet n) : Prop :=
  F.card ≤ f

/-- A node is correct with respect to a concrete faulty set. -/
def CorrectNode {n : ℕ} (F : NodeSet n) (x : Nodes n) : Prop :=
  x ∉ F

  q ≤ Q.card

  {Q | ThresholdQuorum n q Q}

every admissible faulty set.

def ThresholdSafe (n f q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ Q₁ Q₂ : NodeSet n,
    ThresholdQuorum n q Q₁ →
    ThresholdQuorum n q Q₂ →
    ∀ F : NodeSet n,

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Tally (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  forPower : K
  againstPower : K
  abstainPower : K
  totalPower : K
  for_nonneg : 0 ≤ forPower
  against_nonneg : 0 ≤ againstPower
  abstain_nonneg : 0 ≤ abstainPower
  total_nonneg : 0 ≤ totalPower
  present_le_total : forPower + againstPower + abstainPower ≤ totalPower

/-- Shares present: votes for, votes against, and abstentions. -/

def presentPower (t : Tally K) : K :=
  t.forPower + t.againstPower + t.abstainPower

/-- Shares cast: votes for and against, excluding abstentions. -/

def castPower (t : Tally K) : K :=
  t.forPower + t.againstPower

/-- Charter fractions are strictly positive and at most one. -/

def CharterFraction (x : K) : Prop :=
  0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1

/-- The quorum gate: present voting power is at least `q` times total power. -/

def QuorumMet (q : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  q * t.totalPower ≤ presentPower t

/-- Present-basis supermajority: abstentions enter the denominator. -/

def SupermajorityPresent (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  s * presentPower t ≤ t.forPower

/-- Cast-basis supermajority: abstentions are excluded from the denominator. -/

def SupermajorityCast (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  s * castPower t ≤ t.forPower

/-- The institutional basis used for the supermajority denominator. -/

inductive SupermajorityBasis where
  | present
  | cast
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Supermajority with an explicit charter basis. -/

def SupermajorityOnBasis (basis : SupermajorityBasis) (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  match basis with
  | SupermajorityBasis.present => SupermajorityPresent s t
  | SupermajorityBasis.cast => SupermajorityCast s t

/-- Adoption under a specified charter basis. -/

def AdoptedOnBasis (basis : SupermajorityBasis) (q s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  QuorumMet q t ∧ SupermajorityOnBasis basis s t

/-- The present-basis charter convention used by the campaign target. -/

def AdoptedPresent (q s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  AdoptedOnBasis SupermajorityBasis.present q s t

/--
Support has weakly increased while total and present power are held fixed. This
captures converting against-power or abstain-power into for-power without
changing the quorum denominator.
-/

def MoreSupportSamePresent (t u : Tally K) : Prop :=
  t.totalPower = u.totalPower ∧ presentPower t = presentPower u ∧ t.forPower ≤ u.forPower

def zeroTally : Tally K :=
  { forPower := 0
    againstPower := 0
    abstainPower := 0
    totalPower := 0
    for_nonneg := le_rfl
    against_nonneg := le_rfl
    abstain_nonneg := le_rfl
    total_nonneg := le_rfl
    present_le_total := by simp }

def divergenceTallyRat : Tally ℚ :=
  { forPower := 60
    againstPower := 30
    abstainPower := 10
    totalPower := 100
    for_nonneg := by norm_num

    abstain_nonneg := by norm_num

structure ConstantProductPool where
  reserveX : NNReal
  reserveY : NNReal

/-- A pool is live exactly when both reserves are strictly positive. -/

def PoolWellFormed (p : ConstantProductPool) : Prop :=
  0 < p.reserveX ∧ 0 < p.reserveY

/-- The constant-product quantity `k = x*y`. -/

def poolProduct (p : ConstantProductPool) : NNReal :=
  p.reserveX * p.reserveY

/-- Fee factor: the fraction of input that trades against the curve. -/

structure FeeFactor where
  gamma : NNReal
  gamma_pos : 0 < gamma
  gamma_le_one : gamma ≤ 1

/-- A real fee, excluding the feeless boundary. -/

def FeeIsReal (fee : FeeFactor) : Prop :=
  fee.gamma < 1

/-- Swap direction. -/

inductive TradeDirection where
  | xToY
  | yToX
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- A trade is a direction together with a nonnegative input amount. -/

structure Trade where
  direction : TradeDirection
  amount : NNReal

/-- Closed-form X-for-Y swap with input fee. -/

noncomputable def swapXToY (gamma : NNReal) (p : ConstantProductPool) (dx : NNReal) :
    ConstantProductPool where
  reserveX := p.reserveX + dx
  reserveY := p.reserveX * p.reserveY / (p.reserveX + gamma * dx)

namespace FormalizeProbe

structure Valuation (Item K : Type*) [Zero K] [LE K] where
  value : Item → K
  nonneg : ∀ g : Item, 0 ≤ value g

section OrderedField

variable {Agent Item K : Type*}
variable [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

def bundleValue (v : Valuation Item K) (bundle : Finset Item) : K :=
  Finset.sum bundle fun g => v.value g

/-- Anchor (overlap-agreement): bundle value is exactly Mathlib `Finset.sum`. -/

structure Allocation (Agent Item : Type*) where
  owner : Item → Agent

/-- Anchor (characterization): allocation equality is equality of owner functions. -/

def bundle [DecidableEq Agent]
    (goods : Finset Item) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i : Agent) : Finset Item :=
  goods.filter fun g => allocation.owner g = i

/-- Anchor (characterization): membership in a bundle means good membership plus matching owner. -/

def Envies [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i j : Agent) : Prop :=
  bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) <
    bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation j)

/-- Anchor (characterization): envy is the strict bundle-value comparison. -/

def EnvyFree [DecidableEq Agent]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, ¬ Envies profile goods allocation i j

/-- Anchor (characterization): envy-freeness is no strict envy for every ordered pair. -/

def DoesNotEnvyUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (i j : Agent) : Prop :=
  (bundle goods allocation j).Nonempty →
    ∃ g ∈ bundle goods allocation j,
      bundleValue (profile i) (bundle goods allocation i) ≥
        bundleValue (profile i) ((bundle goods allocation j).erase g)

/-- Anchor (characterization): pairwise EF1 is the standard removal implication. -/

def EnvyFreeUpToOneGood [DecidableEq Agent] [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j : Agent, DoesNotEnvyUpToOneGood profile goods allocation i j

/-- Anchor (characterization): EF1 is exactly universal pairwise EF1. -/

def SequentiallyDominates (v : Valuation Item K) (iPicks jPicks : List Item) : Prop :=
  iPicks.Nodup ∧ jPicks.Nodup ∧
    ∀ n (hj : n + 1 < jPicks.length),
      ∃ hi : n < iPicks.length,
        v.value (jPicks.get ⟨n + 1, hj⟩) ≤ v.value (iPicks.get ⟨n, hi⟩)

/-- Anchor (characterization): sequential dominance is nodup plus shifted pointwise comparison. -/

def pickedItems [DecidableEq Item] (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Finset Item :=
  (picks.map Prod.snd).toFinset

/-- Anchor (overlap-agreement): picked items are the `toFinset` of second coordinates. -/

def remainingItems [DecidableEq Item]
    (goods : Finset Item) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) (n : Nat) : Finset Item :=
  goods \ ((picks.take n).map Prod.snd).toFinset

/-- Anchor (characterization): remaining items are goods not yet picked before index `n`. -/

def CoveredAgentOrder (order : List Agent) : Prop :=
  order.Nodup ∧ ∀ i : Agent, i ∈ order

/-- Anchor (characterization): covered orders are nodup lists containing every agent. -/

def PickLogRoundRobin [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (order : List Agent) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Prop :=
  ∃ hlen : 0 < order.length,
    CoveredAgentOrder order ∧
      (picks.map Prod.snd).Nodup ∧
        pickedItems (Item := Item) picks = goods ∧
          ∀ n (hn : n < picks.length),
            let pick := picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩
            pick.1 = order.get ⟨n % order.length, Nat.mod_lt n hlen⟩ ∧
              pick.2 ∈ remainingItems goods picks n ∧
                ∀ g ∈ remainingItems goods picks n,
                  (profile pick.1).value g ≤ (profile pick.1).value pick.2

/-- Anchor (characterization): `PickLogRoundRobin` is the covered trace condition. -/

def PickLogMatchesAllocation
    (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) (picks : List (Agent × Item)) : Prop :=
  ∀ n (hn : n < picks.length),
    allocation.owner (picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩).2 = (picks.get ⟨n, hn⟩).1

def RoundRobin [DecidableEq Item]
    (profile : Agent → Valuation Item K) (goods : Finset Item)
    (order : List Agent) (allocation : Allocation Agent Item) : Prop :=
  ∃ picks : List (Agent × Item),
    PickLogRoundRobin profile goods order picks ∧
      PickLogMatchesAllocation allocation picks

abbrev TwoAgent := Fin 2

abbrev OneGoodItem := Fin 1

def oneGoodSet : Finset OneGoodItem :=
  {(0 : OneGoodItem)}

def oneGoodPositiveValuation : Valuation OneGoodItem K :=
  { value := fun _ => 1
    nonneg := by intro _; norm_num }

def twoAgentOneGoodProfile : TwoAgent → Valuation OneGoodItem K :=
  fun _ => oneGoodPositiveValuation

def oneGoodToAgent0 : Allocation TwoAgent OneGoodItem :=
  { owner := fun _ => 0 }

        {profile : Agent → Valuation Item K} {goods : Finset Item}
        {allocation : Allocation Agent Item},

      ¬ EnvyFree (twoAgentOneGoodProfile (K := K)) oneGoodSet oneGoodToAgent0) := by
  sorry

end OrderedField

end FormalizeProbe

  accountType : AccountType

  | p :: ps => postingResidual p + entryResidual ps

  liabilities : K
  equity : K

  total : ∀ agent {x y}, x ≠ y → pref agent x y ∨ pref agent y x

    (agent : Agent) (x y : Alt) : Prop :=
  x = y ∨ prefs.pref agent x y

def chooseBetterForW (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (w : Woman) (a b : Man) : Man :=
  letI : Decidable (prefW.pref w a b) := prefW.decidablePref w a b
  if prefW.pref w a b then a else b

structure Matching (Man : Type u) (Woman : Type v) where
  held : Woman → Option Man

/-- No man is held by two different women. -/

def NoDuplicateHolds (μ : Matching Man Woman) : Prop :=
  ∀ {w₁ w₂ : Woman} {m : Man}, μ.held w₁ = some m → μ.held w₂ = some m → w₁ = w₂

def emptyMatching : Matching Man Woman :=
  { held := fun _ => none }

  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

    (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Decidable (freeMan μ m) := by
  unfold freeMan
  infer_instance

  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w : Woman, μ.held w = some m then some (Classical.choose h) else none

def FreeManIn (μ : Matching Man Woman) (m : Man) : Prop :=
  ∀ w : Woman, μ.held w ≠ some m

  matching : Matching Man Woman
  rem : Man → List Woman

/-- The opening state: nobody is held, and every man has his full proposal list. -/

def openingState (fullList : Man → List Woman) : ProposalState Man Woman :=
  { matching := emptyMatching, rem := fullList }

def ProposalStepRel (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (m : Man) (next : ProposalState Man Woman) : Prop :=
  (¬ FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ next = state) ∨
    (FreeManIn state.matching m ∧ state.rem m = [] ∧ next = state) ∨
      ∃ w tail,
        FreeManIn state.matching m ∧
          state.rem m = w :: tail ∧
            ((state.matching.held w = none ∧ next.matching.held w = some m) ∨
              ∃ old,
                state.matching.held w = some old ∧
                  next.matching.held w = some (chooseBetterForW prefW w m old)) ∧
              (∀ w', w' ≠ w → next.matching.held w' = state.matching.held w') ∧
                next.rem m = tail ∧
                  ∀ m', m' ≠ m → next.rem m' = state.rem m'

    ProposalState Man Woman → List Man → ProposalState Man Woman → Prop
  | nil (state : ProposalState Man Woman) : ProposalRun prefW state [] state
  | cons {state mid final : ProposalState Man Woman} {m : Man} {schedule : List Man} :
      ProposalStepRel prefW state m mid →
        ProposalRun prefW mid schedule final →
          ProposalRun prefW state (m :: schedule) final

def WomanRejectsManAt (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (state : ProposalState Man Woman) (w : Woman) (rejected : Man) : Prop :=
  ∃ kept : Man, state.matching.held w = some kept ∧ prefW.pref w kept rejected

    ∀ (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man) (fullList : Man → List Woman)
      (pre later : List Man) (stateReject stateLater : ProposalState Man Woman),
      ProposalRun prefW (openingState fullList) pre stateReject →
        ProposalRun prefW stateReject later stateLater →
          ∀ (w : Woman) (rejected : Man),
            WomanRejectsManAt prefW stateReject w rejected →
              ∃ laterHeld : Man,
                stateLater.matching.held w = some laterHeld ∧
                  prefW.pref w laterHeld rejected := by
  sorry

end GaleShapleyStableMatchingProbe

def proposalStep [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]

          | none => some m

    (prefW : StrictPreference Woman Man)
    (initial : ProposalState Man Woman) (schedule : List Man)

  ∀ m, freeMan state.matching m → state.rem m = []

def ProposalRun [Fintype Woman] [DecidableEq Man] [DecidableEq Woman]

variable {K : Type*} [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K]

structure Tally (K : Type*) [Field K] [LinearOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  forPower : K
  againstPower : K
  abstainPower : K
  totalPower : K
  for_nonneg : 0 ≤ forPower
  against_nonneg : 0 ≤ againstPower
  abstain_nonneg : 0 ≤ abstainPower
  total_nonneg : 0 ≤ totalPower
  present_le_total : forPower + againstPower + abstainPower ≤ totalPower

/-- Shares present: votes for, votes against, and abstentions. -/

def presentPower (t : Tally K) : K :=
  t.forPower + t.againstPower + t.abstainPower

/-- Shares cast: votes for and against, excluding abstentions. -/

def castPower (t : Tally K) : K :=
  t.forPower + t.againstPower

/-- Charter fractions are strictly positive and at most one. -/

def CharterFraction (x : K) : Prop :=
  0 < x ∧ x ≤ 1

/-- The quorum gate: present voting power is at least `q` times total power. -/

def QuorumMet (q : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  q * t.totalPower ≤ presentPower t

/-- Present-basis supermajority: abstentions enter the denominator. -/

def SupermajorityPresent (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  s * presentPower t ≤ t.forPower

/-- Cast-basis supermajority: abstentions are excluded from the denominator. -/

def SupermajorityCast (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  s * castPower t ≤ t.forPower

/-- The institutional basis used for the supermajority denominator. -/

inductive SupermajorityBasis where
  | present
  | cast
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Supermajority with an explicit charter basis. -/

def SupermajorityOnBasis (basis : SupermajorityBasis) (s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  match basis with
  | SupermajorityBasis.present => SupermajorityPresent s t
  | SupermajorityBasis.cast => SupermajorityCast s t

/-- Adoption under a specified charter basis. -/

def AdoptedOnBasis (basis : SupermajorityBasis) (q s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  QuorumMet q t ∧ SupermajorityOnBasis basis s t

/-- The present-basis charter convention used by the campaign target. -/

def AdoptedPresent (q s : K) (t : Tally K) : Prop :=
  AdoptedOnBasis SupermajorityBasis.present q s t

/--
Support has weakly increased while total and present power are held fixed. This
captures converting against-power or abstain-power into for-power without
changing the quorum denominator.
-/

def MoreSupportSamePresent (t u : Tally K) : Prop :=
  t.totalPower = u.totalPower ∧ presentPower t = presentPower u ∧ t.forPower ≤ u.forPower

def zeroTally : Tally K :=
  { forPower := 0
    againstPower := 0
    abstainPower := 0
    totalPower := 0
    for_nonneg := le_rfl
    against_nonneg := le_rfl
    abstain_nonneg := le_rfl
    total_nonneg := le_rfl
    present_le_total := by simp }

def divergenceTallyRat : Tally ℚ :=
  { forPower := 60
    againstPower := 30
    abstainPower := 10
    totalPower := 100
    for_nonneg := by norm_num
    against_nonneg := by norm_num
    abstain_nonneg := by norm_num
    total_nonneg := by norm_num
    present_le_total := by norm_num }

theorem exists_present_cast_basis_divergence_rat :
    ∃ t : Tally ℚ,
      CharterFraction (1 / 2 : ℚ) ∧
        CharterFraction (2 / 3 : ℚ) ∧
          0 < t.abstainPower ∧
            QuorumMet (1 / 2 : ℚ) t ∧
              SupermajorityCast (2 / 3 : ℚ) t ∧
                ¬ SupermajorityPresent (2 / 3 : ℚ) t := by
  sorry

open BigOperators

namespace VCG

abbrev Valuation (Outcome K : Type*) := Outcome → K

abbrev ValuationProfile (Agent Outcome K : Type*) := Agent → Valuation Outcome K

noncomputable def finiteMax
    {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [LinearOrder β] (f : α → β) : β :=
  Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty f

def socialWelfare
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (a : Outcome) : K :=
  ∑ i : Agent, r i a

def othersWelfare
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) (a : Outcome) : K :=
  Finset.sum (Finset.univ.erase i) (fun j => r j a)

def updateReport
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [DecidableEq Agent]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) (vi : Valuation Outcome K) :
    ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K :=
  fun j => if j = i then vi else r j

noncomputable def pivotBenchmark
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommMonoid K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  finiteMax (fun a : Outcome => othersWelfare r i a)

def IsWelfareMaximizer
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LE K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (a : Outcome) : Prop :=
  ∀ b : Outcome, socialWelfare r b ≤ socialWelfare r a

axiom exists_welfareMaximizer
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LinearOrder K]
    [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome] (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) :
    ∃ a : Outcome, IsWelfareMaximizer r a

noncomputable def vcgAllocation
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [AddCommMonoid K] [LinearOrder K]
    [Fintype Outcome] [Nonempty Outcome] (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) : Outcome :=
  Classical.choose (exists_welfareMaximizer r)

noncomputable def clarkePivotPayment
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  pivotBenchmark r i - othersWelfare r i (vcgAllocation r)

noncomputable def quasilinearUtility
    {Agent Outcome K : Type*} [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    (trueVal : Valuation Outcome K) (r : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (i : Agent) : K :=
  trueVal (vcgAllocation r) - clarkePivotPayment r i

def DominantStrategyTruthful
    (Agent Outcome K : Type*) [Fintype Agent] [DecidableEq Agent] [Fintype Outcome]
    [Nonempty Outcome] [LinearOrder K] [AddCommGroup K]
    [CovariantClass K K (fun x y => x + y) (· ≤ ·)] : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Agent) (trueVal : Valuation Outcome K)
    (othersReports : ValuationProfile Agent Outcome K) (misreport : Valuation Outcome K),
    quasilinearUtility trueVal (updateReport othersReports i trueVal) i ≥

structure TwoUnitMarginals (K : Type*) where
  first : K
  second : K

def DecreasingMarginals {K : Type*} [LE K] (m : TwoUnitMarginals K) : Prop :=
  m.second ≤ m.first

def twoUnitStepValue {K : Type*} [Zero K] [Add K] (m : TwoUnitMarginals K) (q : Nat) : K :=
  if q = 0 then 0 else if q = 1 then m.first else m.first + m.second

abbrev TwoAgent := Fin 2

abbrev TwoUnitAllocation := Fin 3

def unitsForAgent0 (a : TwoUnitAllocation) : Nat := a.val

def unitsForAgent1 (a : TwoUnitAllocation) : Nat := 2 - a.val

def twoUnitProfile
    {K : Type*} [Zero K] [Add K]
    (m0 m1 : TwoUnitMarginals K) : ValuationProfile TwoAgent TwoUnitAllocation K :=
  fun i a =>
    if i = 0 then
      twoUnitStepValue m0 (unitsForAgent0 a)
    else
      twoUnitStepValue m1 (unitsForAgent1 a)

def twoUnitWitnessTrue0Marginals : TwoUnitMarginals ℚ where

def twoUnitWitness
